title: Ain't Misbehavin'
writers: Thomas "Fats" Waller and Harry Brooks (music), Andy Razaf (lyrics)

evidence.note: Described as a 1929 song, published by Mills Music, with lyrics by Andy Razaf to a score by Fats Waller and Harry Brooks.

famous_use: Stormy Weather (1943), performed by Fats Waller.
